source_note: Original community practice path. Each round is a separate attempt. Content is an AI-assisted preview awaiting practitioner review and calibration; this is not an employer process or a hiring-readiness certification.
name: From Recruiter Screen to Offer
blurb: Practice a screen, learn about the role through candidate questions, and clarify a fictional offer. These rounds do not represent a complete employer hiring process.

rounds.title: Practice a Recruiter Screening Call
rounds.focus: Practice motivation, relevant experience, role questions, and clear next steps in a short screening call.

rounds.title: Use the Final Five Minutes
rounds.focus: Practice questions about expectations, support, working conditions, and real examples so you can judge role fit.

rounds.title: Discuss an Offer and Your Priorities
rounds.focus: Practice clarifying an offer, making a reasoned request, and confirming terms without bluffing.
